title: Quests gave Pollen rewards a home
summary:
This week made Pollen easier to earn and understand, while expanding the audio toolbox and tidying the APIs around it.

A public quest catalog and dashboard let people browse available rewards, check their progress, and claim earned Pollen. A second dashboard view added recent rewards, per-quest earned and claimed totals, and a leaderboard. Guidance now explains earning Pollen through Quests, including contributions and model use.

ElevenMusic gained reference-audio conditioning, composition plans, and tracks saved for later inpainting. Stable Audio expanded from a 2.5 addition to two Stable Audio 3 options: Medium and an alpha Large model, both supporting prompts or reference audio and durations up to 380 seconds. Sound-effects generation and speech in 29 languages joined the audio lineup, and TTS input grew to 10,000 characters. Existing Stable Audio names now alias Medium, whose output is MP3 rather than the earlier WAV.

Activity brought API usage, transactions, and app earnings together. Shared period, key, and model filters make usage and transactions easier to compare; more precise figures keep small nonzero Pollen amounts from looking like zero. Empty states and CSV availability messages now reflect the selected data.

Mercury 2 joined the text models with tool support and a 128,000-token context window. For Gemini, `reasoning_effort` is now the supported reasoning control across Gen, the SDK, and MCP; deprecated `thinking` aliases no longer control it. The text API also leaves image-input acceptance to providers instead of rejecting requests solely on a missing registry label.
